instruction: Please add a new folder to the bookmarks bar in Chrome and name it 'Quick Links'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a bookmark folder named 'Quick Links' on the bookmarks bar. Uses existing Chrome evaluator functions (is_expected_bookmarks with bookmark_bar_folders_names type). No custom functions needed - reuses official getter/metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_bookmarks) correctly extracts bookmark data from Chrome's Bookmarks file at the appropriate OS-specific path

Metric (is_expected_bookmarks with bookmark_bar_folders_names type) correctly verifies that a folder named 'Quick Links' exists on the bookmarks bar by filtering bookmark_bar children for type='folder' and checking if expected names are a subset
Evaluator provides complete coverage of instruction requirements: verifies both folder creation on bookmarks bar AND specific folder name 'Quick Links'
Postconfig is necessary and appropriate: kills and restarts Chrome to ensure bookmarks are written to disk, making verification reliable
Expected value ['Quick Links'] exactly matches the instruction requirement
Verification logic is sound and will work correctly at runtime using Chrome's stable bookmark file format
